title: Jack Friks wiki: from failed ventures to Post Bridge and a solo, organic-marketing playbook
summary: Self-maintained profile tracing Jack Friks from print-on-demand and crypto failures to Curiosity Quench, Post Bridge and Lovelee. Shows a solo founder building tools for his own problems, validating cheaply with short video, marketing organically about an hour a day, and publishing a public ledger of failures.

principles.text: Build products that solve your own problems; it's the easiest route to a business.
principles.quote: easiest way to make a successful business is really just to solve your own problems

principles.text: Validate with a landing page or short video before building; no clicks from real traffic means a weak idea.
principles.quote: if they don't click buy and a thousand people come, clearly the idea is probably not that good.

principles.text: Skip the personal-brand play; build and do cool things, then share them.
principles.quote: to not grow a personal brand at all. It's just to build cool things, do cool things, and then like share them.

principles.text: Market organically with proven short-video formats, reposted until they stop working.
principles.quote: short videos built from formats that have already worked, re-posted until they stop working, with a repeatable "2x2" template that he posted more than 300 times

principles.text: Learning to code stuck only when he was building something he wanted to exist.
principles.quote: it only worked once he was building something he wanted to exist.
